
---
title: "Trends"
---

```{r}
#| message: false

library(tidyverse)
```

```{r}
attacks <- read_rds("data/attacks.rds")
```

```{r}
attacks |>
  add_count(Activity, name = "activity_incidents") |>
  filter(activity_incidents >= 50, Fatal_clean != "Unknown") |>
  count(Activity, Fatal_clean, name = "incidents") |>
  mutate(Activity = fct_reorder(Activity, incidents, .fun = sum)) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = Activity, y = incidents, fill = Fatal_clean)) +
  geom_col(position = "dodge") +
  coord_flip() +
  labs(
    title = "Fatal vs. non-fatal shark attacks by activity",
    x = NULL,
    y = "Number of attacks",
    fill = "Outcome"
  ) +
  theme_minimal()
```
